title: Astro
notes: Astro with the Node adapter in standalone mode, as its deployment guide says. /about is prerendered at build time. The server does not compress by default.
details: Built with astro build and @astrojs/node in standalone mode; the dist/server/entry.mjs entry, which `node ./dist/server/entry.mjs` runs, is imported into the measured process, on Bun and Deno as on Node. It is imported with the documented ASTRO_NODE_AUTOSTART=disabled and the exported startServer() is called, which is what the entry does itself when autostart is on; HOST=127.0.0.1 and PORT=0 are set and the port is read from the listening server. /about is an ordinary .astro page, which Astro prerenders by default; the item page and the API route are marked `prerender = false` so they are rendered per request. The adapter's defaults are kept (it does not compress responses).
